title: fix(components): a field's Esc in the record drawer no longer steps the pane back or restores it from maximized
body:
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao9Er3hy5TVuvBiu4EsvhoLJ)_ Fixes #28156 Clause-②: no Metadata-protocol: none ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么：记录抽屉里，在字段内按 Esc（关提及列表、取消单元格编辑、退出动态输入框或放大面）只归该字段：在下层时不再退回上一层，最大化时不再还原。直接按 Esc（焦点不在字段里）仍退一层、仍还原，根层仍关闭抽屉。 - 为什么改：读者在关联记录里按 Esc 只想关掉字段里的东西，却连带丢了当前层级或最大化宽度。Radix 的对话层在 document 捕获阶段先于任何字段收到 Esc，所以卡片写的那一行 `defaultPrevented` 守卫只挡得住放大面那种窗口捕获监听，挡不住普通字段；本 PR 让抽屉用分屏面已经在用的同一条判断。 - 风险与回滚：只改 `@object-ui/components` 的 `navigation-overlay.tsx` 一个处理函数。代价：焦点停在文本框里时 Esc 永远不退层（与分屏面今天一致），要先移开焦点或点 ←。回滚即 revert 本 PR。 - 先看：`ui/packages/components/src/custom/navigation-overlay.tsx` 的 `handleDrawerEscape` 与 `escapeOwnedByTarget`（新增 `pane` 参数）；`ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/navigation-overlay-field-escape-28156.test.tsx`。 - 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/components/src/__tests__/navigation-overlay-field-escape-28156.test.tsx`，预期 1 个文件、19 个测试全绿。 - 需要你做的：无，席位落地。 ## What changes **Declared deviation from the card's Wanted.** The card asks for `if (e.defaultPrevented) return;` alone. Measured on `main` 69ce01d7 against the installed `@radix-ui/react-dismissable-layer` 1.1.19, that guard is not enough: - The layer listens for `keydown` on the document in the **capture** phase (only while it is the highest layer) and calls `onEscapeKeyDown` from there, then reads `defaultPrevented` for its own dismiss. - So it hears `Esc` before any React `onKeyDown` in the record. A probe through the real `NavigationOverlay` drawer with `onBack`: an input whose React handler calls `preventDefault()` logs `onBack` first and then the field (which sees `defaultPrevented` already true); a field marked handled from a **window** capture listener (the shape #28116's enlarged face uses) logs the face first and then `onBack`. - With the one-line guard, the window-capture case stops stepping back and the React case still does. On `main` the composer's mention list (`RichTextCommentInput`), the grid's `InlineEditing` and the data table's cell editor all take `Esc` in a React `onKeyDown`. Seat 2 chose option B, the guard plus the split pane's ownership test (seat ruling, 2026-10-31T02:56Z, in the dispatch thread). **The drawer's `Esc` (`handleDrawerEscape`).** Below the stack's root, or maximized, the drawer's `onEscapeKeyDown` now: 1. returns when the key is already handled (`defaultPrevented`): an enlarged face or anything else that takes the key ahead of the layer; 2. otherwise holds the sheet open (`preventDefault`, so the layer does not dismiss the whole drawer); 3. leaves the key to its target when `escapeOwnedByTarget` says a text field, an editable region, or an open menu, list box or dialog in the record owns it; 4. only then restores from maximized or steps back one level. This is the question the split pane beside a list already asks (`useSplitEscape`), so the drawer and the split pane now answer `Esc` the same way. **`escapeOwnedByTarget(target, pane?)`.** It takes the pane's own dialog and never counts it as an owner. Every target inside the drawer sits inside the sheet's `role="dialog"`, so without this a button in the record would read as owned and a bare `Esc` there would stop stepping back. The split pane passes nothing and reads as before. **Cost.** With focus in a text field, `Esc` never steps the pane back or restores it, as in the split pane today. The reader moves focus out of the field or uses `←`. **Unchanged.** At the root (no `onBack`, not maximized) the drawer passes no handler and the layer dismisses on `Esc` as before; this card does not cover the root. The split pane's listener is untouched. ## Tests New: `ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/navigation-overlay-field-escape-28156.test.tsx` (19), through the real `NavigationOverlay` (its Radix sheet and its split listener). The record body holds the shapes the fields really take the key in: a cell editor (React `onKeyDown`, `preventDefault`), the composer closing its mention list (React `onKeyDown`, nothing marked), a field inside an enlarged face and the face's own `Esc` (window capture listener, marks handled). - Drawer below the root: `Esc` in each of the four keeps the level (`onBack`, `setIsOpen` and `close` never called). CONTROL: a bare `Esc` steps back once and does not close; an `Esc` on a button in the record steps back too. - Drawer maximized: `Esc` in each of the four keeps it maximized and open. CONTROL: a bare `Esc` restores, and only the next one closes the root. - Split pane beside the list, below the root and maximized: the same four keep the level / the maximized width, and a bare `Esc` steps back / restores (CONTROL; these held before this PR and are pinned for parity).
Ablations (each through node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restore proven blob == HEAD; the test imports the component from source, so no dist leg) On head e2e6e5e9: - A0, the drawer handler back to `main`'s (`e.preventDefault(); handleEscape();`): `Tests 8 failed | 11 passed (19)`, the eight drawer arms (four below the root, four maximized). Controls and split arms green. - A1, the `defaultPrevented` return removed: `2 failed`, the enlarged face's own `Esc`, below the root and maximized. - A2, the ownership test removed: `4 failed`, the cell editor and the composer, below the root and maximized. - A3, `owner !== pane` removed: `1 failed`, the CONTROL that an `Esc` on a button in the record still steps back.
## Acceptance notes - Acceptance item 1 (below the root, field keeps the level; bare `Esc` steps back): pinned in the drawer and in the split pane. - Acceptance item 2 (maximized, field keeps it maximized; bare `Esc` restores): pinned in the drawer and in the split pane. - Acceptance item 3 (against the real `NavigationOverlay`, ablation reds the field case): A0 above. - The root drawer is outside this card: there an `Esc` in a field still dismisses the whole drawer unless something marked it handled ahead of the layer (#28116's face does). Noted, not filed: the card scopes the levels below the root and the maximized pane. ## Verification
Tests, type-check and the derived gates on e2e6e5e9 Head `e2e6e5e9`, change set vs the merge base `69ce01d7`: 3 paths, 251 changed lines. - `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/components/` under the verify lock: `Test Files 1 failed | 461 passed | 1 skipped (463)`, `Tests 5 failed | 4422 passed | 24 skipped (4451)`. The one red file was `share-filter-sort-spec-parity.test.ts`, which reads `@objectstack/spec`'s `.d.ts` and met a closure built with `OS_SKIP_DTS=1` (no declarations). After `env -u OS_SKIP_DTS pnpm turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/components^...'` (exit 0) it and the new file pass: `Test Files 2 passed (2)`. - `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components run type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0. eslint on the two changed source files: exit 0. `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations`: `0 new citation(s)`, exit 0. - `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 34 commands, each run with its exit code captured before any pipe; `--ran` reconcile: `34 derived, 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: `Test Files 169 passed | 2 skipped (171)`. - Not run locally, CI's own: the whole `ui/` suite (Test UI), the other type-check lanes, the repo-wide scans. Dogfood not owed (no `!` in the title, no `(narrowing)` arm). ``` node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main :: exit 0 node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --self-test :: exit 0 node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main :: exit 0 node scripts/check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs :: exit 0 node scripts/check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs --self-test :: exit 0 node scripts/check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs :: exit 0 node scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs --base origin/main :: exit 0 node scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs --self-test :: exit 0 node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs :: exit 0 node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs --self-test :: exit 0 node scripts/pm/release-rehearsal-clone.mjs --self-test :: exit 0 node scripts/release-pending-publish.mjs --self-test :: exit 0 pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:duration-unit-keys :: exit 0 pnpm check:changeset-gate-self-tests :: exit 0 pnpm check:closed-ceremony-text :: exit 0 pnpm check:cross-package-test-inputs :: exit 0 pnpm check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary :: exit 0 pnpm check:driver-memory-census :: exit 0 pnpm check:engine-double-contract :: exit 0 pnpm check:gitlink-declared :: exit 0 pnpm check:nul-bytes :: exit 0 pnpm check:pm-changeset-deadline-census :: exit 0 pnpm check:published-files :: exit 0 pnpm check:query-options-erasure :: exit 0 pnpm check:refd-timer-probe :: exit 0 pnpm check:skill-identifier-liveness :: exit 0 pnpm check:test-source-alias :: exit 0 pnpm check:tier-file-adoption :: exit 0 pnpm check:type-check-coverage :: exit 0 pnpm check:undeclared-dep-imports :: exit 0 pnpm check:watch-hint-literal :: exit 0 pnpm check:where-matcher :: exit 0 pnpm check:type-check-debt :: exit 0 pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/ :: exit 0 ```
